subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should the public `TelegramDmThreadReplies` Plugin SDK type remain as a deprecated compatibility alias through a documented future breaking-release boundary while this runtime configuration key is retired now?
rationale: The branch deliberately narrows a published Plugin SDK entrypoint; repository policy makes external SDK removals compatibility-sensitive and requires explicit ownership of the permanent deprecation boundary.

options.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
options.body: Keep the runtime key retired but export a deprecated type alias so existing external plugin builds continue to compile until an announced breaking release.

options.title: Approve an immediate SDK break
options.body: Allow the removal now only if maintainers explicitly accept the external-plugin build break and publish the upgrade boundary.

recommendation.title: Retain a deprecated type-only alias
recommendation.body: Keep the runtime key retired but export a deprecated type alias so existing external plugin builds continue to compile until an announced breaking release.

likelyOwner.reason: The current author owns the config-reduction series and is the best available routing candidate for the intended SDK deprecation boundary.
